HTTP 200; selectedOffer present with offerId, priceDetails, refundability; V2 additionally carries haveBundles/canBeHeld/isAncillaryRequired/offerHasAncillary/isBaggageRequired/isMealRequired/isSeatMapRequired flags not present in V1's shape.

V1: 200, selectedOffer present | V2: 200, selectedOffer present, flags 7/7

Request: Not run

Access to the live routing layer for direct confirmation
Steps
  1. Send a request to a 'V2'-cased endpoint using 'v2' instead (and vice versa for a 'v2'-cased endpoint) -> observe whether routing still succeeds

If the routing layer is case-insensitive, the inconsistency is cosmetic only; if case-sensitive, this is a latent defect that would affect every V2 endpoint using the 'wrong' casing relative to how it's actually deployed.
Actual Result
Routing is case-insensitive: every endpoint answers identically under both casings (no 404). View Test Case
Preconditions
Search returns at least one offer with a full passengerFareBreakdown
Steps
  1. For each offer: sum(taxesAndFees[].amount.amount) == paxTotalTaxAmount.amount; sum((paxBaseAmount+taxes)*paxCount) reconciles to priceDetails.totalAmount.amount; totalBaseAmount == sum(paxBaseAmount*paxCount); totalTaxAmount == sum(taxes*paxCount)
Expected Result
All four reconciliation checks hold for every offer and every passenger type present.
Actual Result
Totals reconcile but the item-level check cannot hold: V1: 20/20 offers reconcile on totals; taxesAndFees item breakdown missing on 20/20 | V2: 20/20 offers reconcile on totals; taxesAndFees item breakdown missing on 20/20

Preconditions
Search response includes the relevant capability flags for the selected offer
Steps

Flags match between the two responses for the same offer; a flag flipping between steps is itself a defect worth reporting, not expected behavior.

View Test Case
Preconditions
A Held booking with a known original price
Steps
  1. [Hold] -> record priceDetails.totalAmount -> wait -> [FareConfirmAfterHold] POST -> compare reported price against the original Hold price
Expected Result
In the common case, price should match with no drift; a mismatch is the price-drift scenario itself, not necessarily a bug -- report either outcome with the observed delta.
Actual Result
V1: Hold 14340.8 -> reprice 14340.8 (delta 0.00) | V2: Hold 14340.8 -> reprice 14340.8 (delta 0.00) (a mismatch would be the price-drift scenario itself, not a bug)
TC-VOID-BIZ-01 - [Book]&[Void] [Request] Verify Void only succeeds within the window implied by the booking's live voidCapability flag, not merely the static per-supplier Void column.BLOCKED
Endpoint Name: Void a booking flagged as not voidable
Request: Not run
Response: Not applicable
Expected: Void should follow the booking's own void flag
Actual: Blocked: SabreNdc bookings never carry a "VoidNotAllowed" flag, so the case cannot be set up
Status: BLOCKED
Evidence
voidCapability observations this run: Book:(absent) x14, Hold:(absent) x12. See BUG-03 and the 2026-10-22 note that the QR direct Book had no field.
View Test Case
Preconditions
A completed Book with a known voidCapability value
Steps
  1. [Book] -> record voidCapability -> [Void] POST -> observe whether the call succeeds or is rejected, correlated against the recorded voidCapability value
Expected Result
A booking whose voidCapability read 'VoidNotAllowed' at Book time is not voidable; treat the live per-booking flag as authoritative over the static section 4.2 matrix's supplier-level Void column.
Actual Result
Blocked: the precondition cannot be produced on SabreNdc/EGY. voidCapability values seen on responses in this run: Book:(absent) x14, Hold:(absent) x12. Book never returns "VoidNotAllowed" (the field is absent), so there is no booking whose live flag can be compared with a Void outcome.
TC-SUPPLIER-BIZ-01 - [Search]&[FareConfirm] [Response] Verify the generic pre-flow capability-confirmation procedure -- Search's per-offer flags re-confirmed at FareConfirm -- before scheduling any flow against a given supplier.PASS
Endpoint Name: Confirm what SabreNdc supports before testing flows
Request: Searched and confirmed a fare on both versions, comparing the capability flags
Response: V1: Search {"haveBundles":"false","canBeHeld":"true"} | FareConfirm {"haveBundles":false,"canBeHeld":true}; V2: Search {"haveBundles":"false","canBeHeld":"true","offerHasAncillary":"false","isSeatMapRequired":"false","offerHasSeat":"false"} | FareConfirm {"haveBundles":false,"canBeHeld":true,"offerHasAncillary":false,"isSeatMapRequired":false,"offerHasSeat":false,"isAncillaryRequired":false,"isBaggageRequired":false,"isMealRequired":false}
Expected: Flags agree between search and confirm
Actual: SabreNdc/EGY live capability: Hold yes (canBeHeld=true on all offers), Bundle no (haveBundles=false), Ancillary no (offerHasAncillary=false), SeatMap no (isSeatMapRequired=false), Upselling yes (200), Void yes (voids a ticketed booking), CancelAfterHold yes, GetOfferBundles/GetAncillary/GetSeatMap/FareCheck 409 OperationNotSupported.
Status: PASS
Evidence
V1: Search {"haveBundles":"false","canBeHeld":"true"} | FareConfirm {"haveBundles":false,"canBeHeld":true} | V2: Search {"haveBundles":"false","canBeHeld":"true","offerHasAncillary":"false","isSeatMapRequired":"false","offerHasSeat":"false"} | FareConfirm {"haveBundles":false,"canBeHeld":true,"offerHasAncillary":false,"isSeatMapRequired":false,"offerHasSeat":false,"isAncillaryRequired":false,"isBaggageRequired":false,"isMealRequired":false}

View Test Case
Preconditions
A supplier/credentialsSelector pair whose capabilities are Unknown/Conditional per section 4.6
Steps
  1. [Search] with the target supplier -> inspect offers[].haveBundles/.canBeHeld/.offerHasAncillary/.isSeatMapRequired -> [FareConfirm] the chosen offer -> re-confirm the same flags plus isAncillaryRequired/isBaggageRequired/isMealRequired -> record results back into a living copy of section 4.6
Expected Result
Both steps' flags agree with each other; the confirmed result is recorded before any flow from section 5 requiring that capability is scheduled against this supplier.
Actual Result
Both steps agree. SabreNdc/EGY live capability: Hold yes (canBeHeld=true on all offers), Bundle no (haveBundles=false), Ancillary no (offerHasAncillary=false), SeatMap no (isSeatMapRequired=false), Upselling yes (200), Void yes (voids a ticketed booking), CancelAfterHold yes, GetOfferBundles/GetAncillary/GetSeatMap/FareCheck 409 OperationNotSupported.

View Test Case
Preconditions
Access to a non-production environment for this test; awareness that a positive result must be escalated immediately
Steps
  1. [Search] POST with isdebug=true -> inspect supplierRequest/supplierResponse; repeat with isdebug=false; repeat with isdebug omitted -> compare presence/absence of the two fields across all three runs
Expected Result
With isdebug=true, supplierRequest/supplierResponse are present and may contain raw upstream SOAP/XML; the AirArabia observed example's supplierResponse contained apparent live supplier SOAP credentials (wsse:Username/wsse:Password) in plaintext -- any such exposure must be flagged explicitly. Behavior of isdebug=false/omitted is UNKNOWN and must be confirmed live.
